name: Lip Service ~Classmate no JK wa Pinsaro Jou~
original_name: リップサービス～クラスメイトのJKはピンサロ嬢～
source: I've been masturbating to AV a lot lately and it's not enough... Since I turned 18, I decided to go to a pink salon for the first time as a commemoration. By chance, I chose a popular one and the girl who was assigned to me was none other than my classmate Yui Narusawa, who is known for her outstanding figure and beauty. But this might be my chance... as I might be able to receive a blowjob from her as a customer, even though I usually go unnoticed in class.
